fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in the cars by owner section.
findings: Silver paint on hood, doors and rear hatch looks clean but somewhat flat in overcast light
Light haze visible on the driver-side headlight lens
Some dust and road film along the lower rocker panels and rear bumper valance
No interior photos, so the cabin cannot be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lexus RX 450h and it already looks well kept. The headlight lenses show a little haze and the lower panels have some road film, which a pre-sale wash, wax and headlight restoration would clean up for buyer photos. We come to you, and could do the interior too since it isn't shown in the listing. Would you like a quote?
